sources.note: Main homepage. Describes CharmHealth as AI-enhanced all-in-one healthcare platform. Lists core products: EHR, Practice Management, RCM, Patient Engagement, Telehealth, Medical Billing Platform, Connect, Marketplace.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists CharmHealth EHR 1.2 by MedicalMine Inc., certification ID 15.04.04.1948.ChAR.12.00.1.181115. Identifies integrated components: AccessGUDID, Surescripts eRx, IronBridge PubHub, DataMotion Direct. 30 CQMs supported.

EHR product page. Details AI Scribe, CharmAssist, SOAP templates, e-prescribing (70K+ pharmacies), lab integration (LabCorp, Quest), clinical decision support, immunization registry, referral management. Lists supported specialties.

Practice management features. Scheduling with resource management, billing with automated invoices, credit card processing, eligibility verification, claims submission, ERA processing, role-based access, document management, inventory management, secure messaging, analytics.
RCM features. Dashboard, eligibility checks, credentialing, medical coding, claims scrubbing, claims submission, payment posting, denial management, A/R follow-up. Multi-facility support.

Patient portal features. Appointment requests, pre-appointment questionnaires, visit summaries, secure messaging, prescription refills, document sharing, health tracking and goals, lab results access.
Telehealth features. Audio/video consultations, adaptive bandwidth, screen sharing, multi-user sessions, local recording, telehealth kiosk, consent documents. Browser-based, no installation.

CharmConnect secure messaging platform. End-to-end encrypted, group/private chats, audio/video calls, patient-specific channels, document sharing, external inter-practice chat. Integrated with EHR for patient record access.
About page. MedicalMine founded 2007 by Dr. Pramila Srinivasan. VP Sales Dr. Venky Chellappa. Medical advisory board of 13+ physicians. Products: EHR, PM, RCM, Patient Engagement, Telehealth.

Pricing page. Free tier (50 encounters/month), Encounter plan ($0.50/encounter), Provider plan ($200/provider/month). Add-ons for eRx, telehealth, scanning, eCommerce, AI Scribe. Details feature tiers including multi-facility support, billing features, patient portal capacity.
Benefits page. Cloud-based, no infrastructure needed, hosted on Zoho infrastructure, 256-bit encryption, daily/weekly backups, HIPAA/HITECH compliant, MU Certified by Drummond Group.

Integrative medicine specialty page. Custom templates for nutritionists, dietitians, acupuncturists, therapists. Drug-herb interaction database. Holistic documentation for diet, lifestyle, exercise, supplements.

Case study: Capital Integrative Health. 10 practitioners, grew from 0 to 930 patients in 7 months. Uses EHR for collaborative care, claims processing, patient portal. Highlights ease-of-use and cost-effectiveness.
2015 press release. Partnership with EMDI for GCC region distribution. MedicalMine based in Pleasanton, CA. Targets small/medium practices.
2024 press release. Launch of CharmHealthApps marketplace connecting EHR users with third-party vendors. Later replaced by CharmHealthHub.

FindEMR profile. Lists features, pricing, 41 reviews. Specialties: internal medicine, family practice, psychiatry, pediatrics, integrative medicine, dental. Data managed: patient records, demographics, visit notes, vital signs, medications, lab results, imaging, immunizations.

Capterra reviews. Users praise cost-effectiveness and suitability for small practices. Criticisms: customer support delays, system lag during peak usage, extra fees for PDMP and text reminders, slow eRx/EPCS setup.
Software Advice profile. Named Best Free EMR of 2024. Comprehensive feature overview. 403 error on fetch but search results provided summary data.
CharmHealthSquare community launch announcement. References approximately 5,000 licensed physicians as existing CharmHealth EHR users.
2025 press release about CharmHealthHub marketplace launch. Hundreds of apps, partners, and API options. Replaces CharmHealthApps. Developer API access available.
Tracxn company profile. 23 employees as of December 2023. No external funding disclosed.
